install.notes: README.md:12-19 lists gym, libfastsim, pybind11, pyfastsim, pybullet-gym and deap as the dependencies; fastsim/setup.py:6 requires gym>=0.11.0 and pyfastsim. The gate never installs or imports the upstream package: it is needed only to serve the driver with the upstream environment through gym.make (backend sim), which was not run. The fake backend is pure Python.
